title: Central West Alerts 1.9.2
changes: Pager weather now shows the latest bulletin for each area until it is replaced or has gone 24 hours without an update.
Pager map markers retire when a matched official RFS incident closes; the timeline remains in incident history and a fresh page can reopen the job.
SES pages with the same incident number now form one job with all responding units and a clearer incident type.
Recognizable SES street addresses are used for map placement rather than an unrelated town centre.
Unnumbered brigade callsigns now display as station pages.
